_what: Record of the LoRA training run that produced outputs/lora/adapter.
_not_ld_vice: LD-ViCE fine-tunes CogVideoX per dataset AND denoises with target-model gradients. This run did the first half only. Classifier guidance was not used in training and was disabled in both arms of the generation comparison.

trainer.why_this_tag: the main-branch copy calls check_min_version('0.42.0.dev0') and refuses to run against the pinned diffusers 0.36.0; the v0.36.0 copy checks '0.36.0'
trainer.local_patch: skips upstream's post-save pipeline reload when no --validation_prompt is set. Upstream calls pipe.load_lora_weights(output_dir) with no weight_name, which raises under HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and made job 50229034 exit 1 after a successful save. Unpatched original kept as train_cogvideox_lora.py.orig

base_checkpoint.note: base weights untouched; only the adapter was learned

_random_flip_note: left unset deliberately: a horizontal flip would mirror the marked walkway to the wrong side of the aisle

dataset.excluded: 6 clips: 4 by the recording/ambiguity audit, 2 after verifying the window

adapter.checkpoints_note: each holds a 225 MB optimizer.bin for resuming training. They are deliberately NOT in the review package: they are resume state, not review material.

outcome: see outputs/lora/FINDINGS.md - negative, the worker did not move
